name: Good Intentions
overview: Scripture reveals that good intentions alone do not guarantee righteousness, as the heart's motives are weighed by the Lord beyond human self-assessment. While a person may trust in their own integrity and plan carefully, as exemplified by David's plea for divine judgment and the counsel to count the cost before building, true strength and success come from God's sustaining power. Furthermore, even in trials, believers are called to rejoice, recognizing that God works through difficulties to cultivate perseverance and maturity.
